mapper.select: SELECT #{customerId} AS customer_id, s.version_id, s.spec, IF(p.authorized_price, p.authorized_price, s.one_price) AS authorized_price FROM zc_product_version_spc s JOIN zc_product v ON v.version_id = s.version_id AND v.deleted = 0 AND v.id = #{productId} LEFT JOIN zc_customer_version_spec_price p ON s.version_id = p.version_id AND s.spec = p.spec AND p.customer_id = #{customerId} AND p.deleted = 0 WHERE s.deleted = 0 AND s.spec = #{spec} LIMIT 1
